title: Products
description: {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} in your catalog

newPage.title: New product
newPage.description: Create a simple item, a measured product, or a product with variants.

table.emptyDescription: Try adjusting your filters, or add a new product.
table.deleteDescription: If this product has sale or inventory history, it will be archived instead of deleted to preserve your records.

columns.acrossVariants: across {count, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}}

setup.title: Choose the simplest setup that fits
setup.description: Pick one. It sets the options below for you — you can still change them by hand.
setup.simpleDescription: Charger, shampoo, canned food, or any item sold as one SKU.
setup.measuredDescription: Rice by kilogram, fabric by meter, or oil by liter.
setup.variantsDescription: Clothing sizes, phone storage, cosmetic shades, or flavors.

identity.title: Product identity
identity.description: Only the name and SKU are required. Add a category to unlock its specifications.
identity.namePlaceholder: e.g. Organic rice, T-shirt, Wireless headset
identity.noCategoryHint: You can save now and organize the product into a category later.
identity.descriptionPlaceholder: Useful details for staff and catalog records

selling.title: How this product is sold
selling.description: Keep a single SKU, sell by a unit of measure, or manage separate variant SKUs.
selling.hasVariantsHint: Use for options with their own SKU, price, or stock—such as size, color, storage, shade, or flavor.
selling.saveThenManageVariants: Save changes, then manage each variant below.
selling.createBaseFirst: Create the base product first; you will add individual variants from its edit page.
selling.unitHint: Choose how stock and sale quantities are counted.
selling.partialQuantitiesHint: Enable for values such as 0.5 kg or 1.25 L.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Pick every size you sell. Combined with the colors below, one variant is created per combination.
sizes.pickHint: Pick one or more, or leave this off if the product has no sizes.
sizes.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# size} other {# sizes}} selected.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Pick every color you sell. Each one becomes a variant with its own SKU and stock.
colors.pickHint: Pick one or more. The first is the primary color.
colors.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# color} other {# colors}} selected.

form.variantCountNote: {count} {count, plural, one {variant} other {variants}} will be created with zero stock{combo}. Set their stock and prices from the product's edit page.
form.variantCountCombo: ({sizeCount, plural, one {# size} other {# sizes}} × {colorCount, plural, one {# color} other {# colors}})

pricing.title: Pricing and inventory
pricing.descriptionVariants: Set default prices here. Stock is entered separately for each variant after the product is saved.
pricing.descriptionSimple: Set the prices and available stock{unitSuffix}.
pricing.marginNegativeWarning: — the cost price is above the selling price.

legacy.title: Optional legacy details
legacy.description: Use only if your catalog already relies on a single product type, size, or color.

images.title: Product images
images.description: Optional. Add up to 6 images; the first image becomes the cover.

form.toastSaveFailed: Could not save the product. Please try again.

variants.cardDescription: Each variant has its own SKU, stock and optional price.
variants.emptyDescription: Add per-size / per-color variants so this product can be sold.
variants.deleteDescription: If it has already been sold it will be deactivated instead of deleted.

dialog.description: Leave price/cost empty to use the product's values.

imageUploader.toastUploadFailedRetry: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

actions.stockWholeNumber: Stock and minimum stock must be whole numbers for this product.
actions.skuOrBarcodeExists: A product with that SKU or barcode already exists.

variant.stockWholeNumber: Stock must be a whole number for this product.
variant.skuExists: A variant with that SKU already exists.
variant.batchTrackedCreateZero: This product is batch-tracked — create the variant with zero stock, then receive stock into a batch.
variant.batchTrackedAdjustElsewhere: This product is batch-tracked — change variant stock through batch receiving or adjustment.
